name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) "2nd Point" Sweet Pulled Pork Sandwich (Slaw on Side)
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted pork shoulder is exceptionally tender with broken-down muscle fibers. Strained seedless raspberry BBQ sauce adds sweet flavor without seeds. Order coleslaw on the side.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the 2nd Point Pulled Pork sandwich on an artisan bun with coleslaw served on the side (so raw cabbage roughage does not touch your sandwich).
watchOuts: Do not eat raw cabbage coleslaw during digestive flareups
